title: Annex 71 source timing, fabric, and mass-state diagnostics

numerical_tolerances.material_cross_period_improvement: at least 10 percent lower unexplained-gain MAE in both periods
numerical_tolerances.initial_mass_state_materiality: at least 10 percent post-warmup MAE span
numerical_tolerances.roof_tilt: exact 30 degrees from the official dimensioned plan

known_deviations: This is post-hoc diagnosis and cannot pass blind or untouched validation gates.
No tested one-hour source shift, heater split, initial mass-temperature offset, or floor-area capacity allocation satisfies the frozen cross-period materiality rule.
The source-determined 30-degree roof tilt is applied without fitting; its effect is small and does not change the empirical rejection.
Component-resolved fabric topology, per-opening blind state, and a time-varying cellar boundary remain unsupported on the canonical path.
No counterfactual correction or additional calibration is authorized by this result.
